sentences.japanese: イエス、ナタナエルの己が許に來たるを見、これを指して言ひ給ふ「視よ、眞にイスラエル人なり、その衷に噓僞なし」。
sentences.english: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit."

sentences.japanese: ラビ、視よ、汝とともにヨルダンの彼方にありし者、なんぢが證せし者、バプテスマを施し、人みなその許に往くなり。
sentences.english: Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan - the one you testified about - well, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him.

sentences.japanese: かつて女性の喫煙はタブー視されていた。
sentences.english: It used to be taboo for women to smoke.

sentences.japanese: 人はテレビを視るよりも直そうとする方がより多くを学ぶ。
sentences.english: You learn more from trying to repair a TV than from watching one.
